scope: Public native IOSurface content seed versus CF alias, stable ID, read-only/noop/write lock and controlled byte mutations
prediction: Read-only lock/snapshot leaves seed unchanged; write unlock increments even without changed bytes. Active/padding/tail changes and exact restoration each increment; original/alias agree. Thus seed is not byte hash and identical bytes can have different seed. Canvas generations remain separate.

header_provenance.summary: SDK declares modification-seed return at lock and increment on write unlock; declaration separate from runtime.
